name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-figma-libraries
title: Red, violet and cyan halftone wave banner with a paper-clipped 'figma libraries' folder
whatItIs: A wide banner with coarse halftone dots in red, violet, blue and cyan forming layered waves, a manila folder with a paper clip and 'figma libraries' in serif, a pixel cursor, four dark app icons and a white scribble burst at the corner.
whatItMeans: Vivid and nostalgic; wave-like halftone gives the desktop metaphor motion.
techniques: Form waves from halftone colour bands.
Clip a paper to the folder.

vocabulary.definition: Layered wavy shapes rendered in dots.
A clip graphic attached to a folder.
A black rounded square with a tool logo.
A serif label on a folder.
